I farm here 30 years, so I know what works on my land. My 7.5 mu I split like this: 5 mu for wheat-maize rotation, 2.5 mu for cotton on the sandier plot where cotton does better.

For wheat this autumn — I will plant Jimai improved variety, same as last three years, my neighbors got 480 kg with it. I put down 2 bags of compound fertilizer (45% 15-15-15) per mu as base, that is about 30 kg. Then topdress with urea 15 kg per mu at jointing when I irrigate. Total nitrogen maybe 28 kg per mu. I irrigate 4 times — before sowing, winter water, jointing, grain filling. Two sprays for aphids and rust. Rotary till after maize harvest, no time to deep plough. Expect about 475 kg per mu, similar to last year.

For summer maize — Zhengdan hybrid seed, I buy new every year, cannot save it. Direct seed into wheat stubble, no tillage, saves me labor and diesel. 25 kg urea as base plus 20 kg urea topdress at big flare stage. Compound fertilizer 20 kg. Irrigate 2 times if rain is short, the well water costs electricity. Two sprays — one for borer, one for armyworm if I see them. Should get 525 kg per mu.

For cotton — this is more work, more pesticide money. Bt hybrid seed for bollworm resistance. Lower nitrogen because too much makes it grow tall with no bolls, I learned that years ago. 15 kg N, more potassium 10 kg because cotton needs K for bolls. Plough deep before planting, cotton likes loose soil. Irrigate 3 times. Six sprays at least — aphids, mites, bollworm late season. Expect 280 kg seed cotton per mu, prices are not great but I keep growing it.
